blocks.text: Jeremiah 46 belongs to the collection of oracles concerning nations in chapters 46–51 of the Masoretic form of the book. The received book of Jeremiah brings together poetry, prose sermons, narratives, letters, headings, restoration collections, nation oracles, and an appendix through a long compositional and textual history. Scholars also note that the ancient Old Greek form is markedly shorter and places the nation oracles earlier and in a different order. These features remain matters of scholarly discussion.
